column1: Whisk the coffee, amaretto, and vanilla together in a shallow dish.
Beat the egg yolks and sugar with a hand mixer until pale and thick, about 5 minutes.
Add the mascarpone and salt and beat until smooth.
In another bowl, whip the cream to stiff peaks, about 5 minutes, then fold it into the mascarpone mixture until light and airy.
Use 4 Le Creuset Mini Round Cocotte pots for 4 individual servings. Quickly dip each ladyfinger on both sides in the coffee mixture and line the bottom of each pot, cutting them to fit.
Spread a layer of mascarpone cream over the ladyfingers and dust with cocoa.
Add another layer of dipped ladyfingers, then another layer of cream, dividing the ladyfingers and cream evenly among the 4 pots. Finish with a generous dusting of cocoa.
Cover and chill at least 4 hours; longer is better.
